#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

load() {
  local f="$1"
  if [[ -f "$f" ]]; then
    cat "$f"
  fi
}

for f in src/*.rs; do
  rg -n "fn " "$f" || true
done

if [[ -d data ]]; then
  find data -name '*.txt' | while read -r p; do
    echo "$p"
  done
fi

ls -l | head -n 20
git status --short
cargo test --offline

rtk git status
python3 -m rtk_kan train --steps 50
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
chmod +x scripts/*.sh
